text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The winner was Symboli Kris S.
I thought I had closed the gap a little,
but there was 
still a vast difference in the
fundamental brilliance of our runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose,
having lofty aspirations with 
eyes fixed firmly on the goal. That is 
something Hishi Miracle does not possess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Could she truly keep up with all of this 
going forward?
Hishi Miracle was seized by 
intense anxiety.
